'''Dom Pedro's guard''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
This man was a guard working for [[Dom Pedro (character)|Dom Pedro]]. In 2296, he was stationed in Dom Pedro's fortress to watch over [[the Ghoul's grave]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
Standing at his post, the guard tries to light a [[cigarette]] for himself, but is then killed by a baby doll's arm that was shot into his chest by a [[Junk Jet (TV series)|Junk Jet]]. The person who killed him was [[Biggie]], who stood beside [[Slim (TV series)|Slim]] and his boss [[Honcho]].<ref>{{fotv|1|1}}</ref>

==Appearances==
Dom Pedro's guard appears only {{in|FOTV}}.

The '''elderly speaker''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
An elderly [[Vault 33]] dweller who was seen wearing a ceremonial [[stole]] over his [[vault suit (TV series)|vault suit]] while officiating weddings.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
In the series premiere episode "[[The End (episode)|The End]]", the elderly speaker officiates the wedding of [[Lucy MacLean]] and [[Monty (TV series)|Monty]]. Lucy later finds him dead, having been killed and impaled to the wall of the armory by a [[Vault 32 raider|raider]] with a [[machete (TV series)|machete]].

==Appearances==
The elderly speaker appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
{{FOTV appearances|1=101}}

* While the [[stole]] worn by this character resembles that worn by [[Christianity|Christian]] clergy of various denominations, him being a priest is never directly stated in the series (he is credited only as "elderly speaker"), and instead of Christian symbols, it features the [[Vault-Tec]] logo.

'''Emil Dale''' is the director of the movie ''[[The Man from Deadhorse]]'' {{In|FOTV}}.<ref name="FalloutTV">{{fotv|1|3}}</ref>

==Background==
Emil Dale was a filmmaker who directed the movie ''The Man from Deadhorse'' starring [[Cooper Howard]]. He was [[Cadillac Bob]]'s boss at [[California Crest Studios]] until Bob was fired for alleged [[Communism|communist]] sympathies.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

==''Fallout'' TV series==
==="[[The Head]]"===
During the scene in ''The Man from Deadhorse'' where Cooper's character, the Sheriff, is supposed to kill the villain [[Jorge|Joey Toro]], Cooper hesitates and, out of character, asks if he really has to kill him, leading the director Emil to cut the filming. Cooper then asks to speak with Emil, who walks toward him by the set and listens to Cooper's concern over the newly revised script. In Cooper's opinion, he shouldn't kill him, but rather arrest the villain like he normally does. However, Emil mentions that the audience already knows Cooper's a "good man" and would like to see that even a good man like himself can sometimes be driven "too far" sometimes. However, Cooper argues that this is not how he does things.<ref name="FalloutTV" />

The '''administrator''' is a character {{in|FOTV}}.

==Background==
The administrator supervised scientific experiments performed by various [[Enclave scientist (TV series)|Enclave scientists]] at an [[Enclave research colony]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Target]]===
In [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], the administrator discovers that [[Siggi Wilzig]] was keeping [[CX404]] as a secret pet in his laboratory. In the ensuing confrontation, he throws Siggi to the ground after a brief struggle, before sounding the alarm. CX404 leaped to defend her master, tearing the administrator's throat out and forcing Wilzig to flee the facility with her.

==Appearances==
The administrator appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
